content.title: Things To Do | Think Iowa City
content.text: Discover Things to Do in the Iowa City & Coralville Area Discover the perfect mix of culture and adventure across Iowa City, Coralville, and North Liberty. Explore iconic attractions like the Old Capitol Museum and Iowa River Landing, or enjoy outdoor recreation on our interconnected trail systems and waterways. Experience our vibrant arts scene with performances at Hancher Auditorium and the Englert Theatre. Shop unique local boutiques in our charming downtown and modern retail districts. Families will love our interactive museums, parks, and seasonal events that create lasting memories. Whether you’re visiting or looking for fun things to do near me this weekend, our communities offer exciting experiences for every interest and age group! browse activities & attractions Create your own adventure with these local favorites that showcase the best our region has to offer. Discover hidden gems and must-see destinations that capture the unique spirit of Iowa City, Coralville, and North Liberty—click any attraction to begin creating your perfect itinerary. getting curious? Explore Downtown Iowa City Downtown Iowa City is a vibrant and walkable business and entertainment district located directly across from the University of Iowa campus with many locally owned restaurants, shops, and entertainment options. LEARN MORE Explore the Iowa River Landing in Coralville This walkable district seamlessly combines shopping and relaxation with scenic views of the Iowa River, creating an inviting destination for visitors and locals alike. LEARN MORE A Big Ten Creative Capital The University of Iowa thrives in the heart of Iowa City. It is ranked among the top 35 public institutions by U.S. News & World Report, offering over 200 options for majors, minors, and certificates. The University is renowned for its research and top-notch comprehensive healthcare system. LEARN MORE Hawkeyes & Beyond Feel the energy surge through Iowa City as Hawkeye teams battle Big Ten rivals in storied venues where traditions run deep and every victory is celebrated citywide. For a different sporting thrill, catch our local ECHL Professional hockey team, the Iowa Heartlanders at Xtream Arena, where fast breaks and precision play make hockey nights an essential local experience. LEARN MORE Iowa City’s Literary Legacy Iowa City is rich with literary history, notably due to the presence of the University of Iowa Writers’ Workshop, established in 1936 as the first creative writing degree program in the United States. Whether you’re seeking outdoor thrills, cultural immersion, retail therapy, family fun, or iconic attractions, each adventure begins with just a click.
